verses.gurmukhi: ਭਗਤੁ ਭਗਤੁ ਜਗਿ ਵਜਿਆ ਚਹੁ ਚਕਾਂ ਦੇ ਵਿਚਿ ਚਮਿਰੇਟਾ।
verses.translit_en: bhagat bhagat jag vajiaa chahu chakaa(n) dhe vich chamireTaa|

en.bdb: The tanner (Ravidas) became renowned as bhagat (saint) in all the four directions.

verses.gurmukhi: ਪਾਣ੍ਹਾ ਗੰਢੈ ਰਾਹ ਵਿਚਿ ਕੁਲਾ ਧਰਮ ਢੋਇ ਢੋਰ ਸਮੇਟਾ।
verses.translit_en: paanhaa ga(n)ddai raeh vich kulaa dharam ddoi ddor sameTaa|

en.bdb: In accordance with his family tradition he would cobble the shoes and carry away the dead animals.

verses.gurmukhi: ਜਿਉ ਕਰਿ ਮੈਲੇ ਚੀਥੜੇ ਹੀਰਾ ਲਾਲੁ ਅਮੋਲੁ ਪਲੇਟਾ।
verses.translit_en: jiau kar maile cheethaRe heeraa laal amol paleTaa|

en.bdb: This was his outward routine but in reality he was a gem wrapped in rags.

verses.gurmukhi: ਚਹੁ ਵਰਨਾ ਉਪਦੇਸਦਾ ਗਿਆਨ ਧਿਆਨੁ ਕਰਿ ਭਗਤਿ ਸਹੇਟਾ।
verses.translit_en: chahu varanaa upadhesadhaa giaan dhiaan kar bhagat saheTaa|

en.bdb: He would preach all the four varnas (castes).  His preaching made them rapt in the meditative devotion for the Lord.

verses.gurmukhi: ਨ੍ਹਾਵਣਿ ਆਇਆ ਸੰਗੁ ਮਿਲਿ ਬਾਨਾਰਸ ਕਰਿ ਗੰਗਾ ਥੇਟਾ।
verses.translit_en: nhaavan aaiaa sa(n)g mil baanaaras kar ga(n)gaa theTaa|

en.bdb: Once, a group of people went to Kasi (Varanasi) to have their sacred dip in the Ganges.

verses.gurmukhi: ਕਢਿ ਕਸੀਰਾ ਸਉਪਿਆ ਰਵਿਦਾਸੈ ਗੰਗਾ ਦੀ ਭੇਟਾ।
verses.translit_en: kadd kaseeraa saupiaa ravidhaasai ga(n)gaa dhee bheTaa|

en.bdb: Ravidas gave one dhela (half a pice) to one member and asked him to offer it to the Ganges.

verses.gurmukhi: ਲਗਾ ਪੁਰਬੁ ਅਭੀਚ ਦਾ ਡਿਠਾ ਚਲਿਤੁ ਅਚਰਜੁ ਅਮੇਟਾ।
verses.translit_en: lagaa purab abheech dhaa ddiThaa chalit acharaj ameTaa|

en.bdb: A great festival of Abhijit naksatr (star) was on there where the public saw this wonderful episode.

verses.gurmukhi: ਲਇਆ ਕਸੀਰਾ ਹਥੁ ਕਢਿ ਸੂਤੁ ਇਕੁ ਜਿਉ ਤਾਣਾ ਪੇਟਾ।
verses.translit_en: liaa kaseeraa hath kadd soot ik jiau taanaa peTaa|

en.bdb: Ganges, herself taking out her hand accepted that paltry amount, dhela, and proved that Ravidas was one with Ganges as warp and weft.

verses.gurmukhi: ਭਗਤ ਜਨਾਂ ਹਰਿ ਮਾਂ ਪਿਉ ਬੇਟਾ ॥੧੭॥
verses.translit_en: bhagat janaa(n) har maa(n) piau beTaa ||17||

en.bdb: For bhagats (saints,) God is their mother, father and son all in one.
